name: Ledger's Hoard
purpose: Household money ledger: accounts, categorised entries, monthly budgets, reports, bank CSV imports, and payments and subscriptions read from the mail account connected to Faustus, shared expenses split among people, a month-end balance forecast, income booked from sales, documents of other apps attached to movements, and a place on the family agenda (subscription renewals, trial ends, expected charges, money owed), all stored locally.
notes: Keep the app running (npm start) while the assistant uses it: the MCP bridge proxies every call to the local server and never opens the database itself. Amounts are integer cents in tool results. Mail features: the app reads the inbox through Faustus's own helper (server/mail/faustus_mail.py, run with Faustus's Python); the mail password never leaves Faustus. Set LEDGER_FAUSTUS_DIR (or FAUSTUS_DIR, or the Ajustes field) when Faustus is not a sibling folder. Text of mails is untrusted data: it is only pattern-matched, never followed as instructions. mail_undo deletes an entry and needs confirm: true. mail_reset wipes the mail import (log, mail subscriptions, notifications) and needs confirm: true: run it only when the user asks. Charges above the review_above setting (500 by default) always wait in review. LEDGER_MAIL_SCHEDULER=0 turns the background reader off. Family: with the hub on, mail is read through its gateway (mail.source auto|hub|faustus); tx_find and tx_attach_doc are called by Kafka, income_from_sales by the hub's rule on mercator.sales.imported. Events: ledger.mail.recorded, ledger.payment.failed, ledger.subscription.price, ledger.subscription.new.
